text:
jana: FYI planning to split backup-uploader role tomorrow into uploader-read/uploader-write. Found 2 compliance issues: (A) some restores use grants issued to the old role ARN, (B) legacy agent leaves .sql.tmp at 0644 until upload finishes.
liam: that tmpfile is bad. Multi-tenant nodes could read it. Quick fix: open with O_EXCL + 0600 and atomic rename.
asha: agree. i'll do a hotfix PR and a canary rollout. also saw staging allowing PutObject with no SSE headers - we need a short-term bucket deny.
liam: sample bucket policy (deny non-sse for uploader-write) ready. will scope to role ARN so other services aren't impacted.
jana: followups: 1) patch agent (hotfix) 2) deploy canary image 3) apply bucket deny for prod-backups 4) audit last 30 days for objects without SSE 5) grant migration for CMKs used by backups 6) revoke old grants after validation.
asha: vuln scan caught one long-lived grant created manually in 2023. must revoke and replace with short-lived grant-for-restore flow.
liam: migration approach: for each CMK create a short-lived grant for new role, update restore workers to request grant_id from encops service, test restore, then revoke old grant. Script will stash grantIds in secrets manager.
ops-bot: ALERT: canary `uploader-staging-3` shows AccessDenied on KMS:Decrypt.
jana: hold the prod flip until canary fixed. ashta -> finish PR and push canary (ETA 90m), liam -> apply bucket deny (ETA 30m), jana -> run audit and open remediation ticket (ETA 2h), liam -> publish grant migration script (ETA 3h).
asha: PR includes a runtime safety check to abort upload if tempfile perms >0600 and a unit test asserting secure mode.
ci-bot: CI queued: `backup-agent:secure-tempfile` canary build pending manual approval.
liam: also adding CloudTrail metric for `PutObject` without SSE and for `CreateGrant` events to alert the security channel.
jana: do not mass-revoke grants until restores validated. Plan staged revokes and a canary revoke to assert failure of revoked grant.
asha: created ticket SEC-3012 for unencrypted-uploads + grant migration; assigned to @jana and @liam.
jana: once hotfix + S3 policy live we'll do a controlled re-copy of one affected snapshot to SSE-KMS and run a restore smoke test. will capture for compliance audit. Keep updates here. :white_check_mark:
